llm: disabled; local LLM rewrite is opt-in

system_audio.microphone_permission: Mic capture uses FFmpeg AVFoundation and requires the terminal or parent app to have macOS Microphone permission.
system_audio.routing_permission: BlackHole is not visible as a local audio input, so system audio cannot be captured through the Phase 9 adapter.

mcp.note: `comlink mcp` is a local stdio server launched by the MCP client and opens no network listener; MCP clients may start recordings (mcp.allow_start=true); meeting_get_transcript and transcript resources send transcript text to the calling model
